    grid-columns: 6

  - id: communication-products

    sort: "date desc"

    sort-ui: false

    fields: [image, title]
    page-size: 100
execute:
  freeze: true
format: 
  html: 
    page-layout: article
    css: portfolio.css
    include-after-body: |
     document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
     document.querySelectorAll("a.quarto-grid-link").forEach(el => {
     el.removeAttribute("target");
     });
     });
